title: Autonomous investigation of substituent effects on pentalene antiaromaticity
difficulty_reasons: The chemical systems and observable are fixed, while the Agent must formulate and discriminate explanations for any computed substituent effect and justify validation and limitations.

paper.title: Modular synthesis of benzothiophene-fused pentalenes reveals substituent-dependent antiaromaticity

data.description: Closed system identities and NICS probe definition for 4a and 4c.

required_deliverables.description: Independent validated results, explanations, discrimination evidence, comparison, and conclusion.
